piece.headline: HITESH TOPS THE TABLE, ALESTON FALLS AWAY
piece.standfirst: Hitesh takes top spot, with Prathap breathing down his neck. Mayuresh's Bench Boost haul was the week's big story.
piece.big_picture: Hitesh is top, and Aleston is out of the top spot after a quiet week. Prathap is only 2 points back, with Rajat Arora close behind. 3 managers are separated by a handful of points, so one bad week could change the order again.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Aryan Apte captained Groß instead of Palmer. Groß gave 34 with the armband against Palmer's 10. A 24-point swing against the 54 who followed the crowd. Nerve, and it worked.
piece.one_to_watch: Hitesh leads Prathap by 2 points in the title race. Prathap has used his Triple Captain already, so if Hitesh's captain blanks next week, the top spot could swap again.

winners.name: Hitesh
winners.verdict: Took top spot with a big week. Left 23 points on the bench, so the title race could get nasty.

winners.name: Cherag
winners.verdict: Triple Captain and Rogers came in, and the league's 7th spot followed. Bold call, good result, 15 points still wasted on the bench.

losers.name: Yash Gawai
losers.verdict: 15 points of transfers, including Rogers and Konsa, and a fall of 50 places. A busy week that sadly did not pay off.

losers.name: Kashish
losers.verdict: Played the Wildcard and slid 47 places to 67th. The reshuffle didn't pay, and the chip is gone now.
